title: connection.select_all binds regression
body:
### Steps to reproduce
```
rails new test
cd test
rails g model post body:string
rake db:migrate
rails console
Post.connection.select_all('SELECT id FROM posts WHERE id > $1', 'SQL', [[nil, 0]])
```

### Expected behavior
This normally work in Rails 4.2.7.1
